paper_title: Searching for scalar field dark matter with LIGO
notes: Direct search for scalar field dark matter using LIGO O3 data via the beamsplitter/test-mass expansion effect. The paper sets 95% C.L. upper limits on coupling constants Lambda_gamma (photon coupling, d_e / alpha variation -> ScalarPhoton) AND Lambda_e (electron-mass coupling, d_me -> ScalarElectron), shown in Fig. 3a/3b. Frequency band 10 Hz to 180 Hz corresponds to ~5e-14 eV to 1e-12 eV (competitive up to 5000 Hz). Local DM density rho_CDM = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed. No numerical table is provided; limits appear only in smoothed Fig. 3, so no reliable (mass, coupling) data points could be extracted.
